name: @sematico/shopify-e2e
description: CLI-first orchestration for isolated Shopify Playwright E2E tests.

scripts.lint: biome check bin src tests package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json vitest.config.ts biome.json
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:fast
scripts.test:fast: vitest run --exclude tests/installed-cli.test.ts --exclude tests/installed-doctor-cli.test.ts --exclude tests/installed-playwright-fixtures.test.ts --exclude tests/browser-role-isolation.test.ts --exclude tests/browser-playwright-fixtures.test.ts
scripts.test:browser:fixtures: npm run build && vitest run tests/browser-playwright-fixtures.test.ts
scripts.test:browser:roles: npm run build && vitest run tests/browser-role-isolation.test.ts
scripts.test:installed: npm run build && npm run test:installed:built
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:fast && npm run test:installed:built
